name: Colorado

items.label: Colorado taxable income
items.note: Starts from federal taxable income. Above $300,000 of income, all but $1,000 ($2,000 married) of the federal standard deduction is added back.

items.label: FAMLI paid leave
items.note: Half of the 0.88% premium, on wages up to the Social Security wage base.

notModelled: Local occupational privilege taxes (Denver, Aurora, Glendale, Greenwood Village, Sheridan) of a few dollars a month
